explore.description: Performs bounded local repository discovery and dependency tracing.

researcher.description: Performs bounded external and version-specific research using authoritative sources.

implementer.description: Performs bounded implementation work within explicit caller-owned files or subsystems.

debugger.description: Investigates failures and returns evidence-based root cause analyses and resolution guidance.

documenter.description: Drafts ready-to-apply technical documentation and returns it to the calling agent.

reviewer.description: Independently reviews changes for correctness, regressions, convention compliance, and readiness.
